gltfhandler-error-unknown: Error shown when a glTF file contains sections that cannot be parsed.
gltfhandler-error-unsupportedversion: Error shown when a glTF file uses an unsupported version of the format.
gltfhandler-error-invalidschema: Error shown when a glTF file's metadata does not conform to the expected schema.
gltfhandler-error-uriresolutionembedded: Error shown when a glTF file contains an invalid embedded resource URI.
gltfhandler-error-uriresolutionlocal: Error shown when a glTF file refers to a local resource that cannot be accessed.
gltfhandler-error-uriresolutionremote: Error shown when a glTF file refers to a remote resource that cannot be accessed.
